note: AE = Airframe and Engine/MLX；AV = Avionics；AI = Aircraft Interior。三本第1-30句完全相同，存于 shared，三本共用（页码三本一致）。页码按英文所在页记。三本已全部录入（AE 80句、AV 80句、AI 79句）。AI第49句和第75句英文相同、中文略不同，分在第4页和第6页，两句都保留。

shared.en: To get access to the air-driven pump (ADP) for the applicable engine, open the trailing edge fairing access doors on the left and right sides of the strut.
shared.zh: 为了进入相应发动机的气动泵，打开吊架左右两边上的后缘整流罩检修门。

shared.en: Get access to the applicable access doors.
shared.zh: 进入适用的检修门。

shared.en: No painting operations are permitted on airplanes with open fuel tanks.
shared.zh: 当油箱开着时，不允许在飞机上进行喷漆。

shared.en: Do not use electrical test equipment which can cause sparks in a fuel tank.
shared.zh: 不要使用在油箱里会导致火星的电测试设备。

shared.en: Make sure the airplane is clear of all structures and other airplanes.
shared.zh: 确保飞机周围没有任何结构和其它飞机。

shared.en: Make sure that the engine inlet and exhaust hazard areas are clear for all of the engines.
shared.zh: 确保所有发动机的进气口和排气口危险区域已经清场。

shared.en: Make sure that persons do not get near an engine that is in operation.
shared.zh: 确保人们不走近正在运转的发动机。

shared.en: Make sure the ground fire extinguisher equipment is in its position with the applicable persons.
shared.zh: 确保地面灭火瓶设备就位并有合适的人员在旁边。

shared.en: Make sure that persons with loose clothing do not go near the engine.
shared.zh: 确保穿着宽松衣服的人不会走近发动机。

shared.en: After 24 hours of cure time, remove the tape.
shared.zh: 24小时的固化时间之后，去除胶带。

shared.en: DISCARD ALL PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT AFTER YOU USE IT ONE TIME. DO NOT TRY TO CLEAN IT. DISCARD THE EQUIPMENT IN A PLASTIC DISPOSAL BAG.
shared.zh: 在你使用完个人防护设备后，请丢掉。不要试图清洁它，并把它丢在塑料垃圾袋里。

shared.en: Service the hydraulic reservoirs and accumulators before you operate each engine.
shared.zh: 在你起动每一台发动机之前，为液压缸和蓄压器做勤务。

shared.en: Make sure that the thrust reverser is in the closed position before servicing the power unit.
shared.zh: 在你为动力装置做勤务之前，确保反推装置处于关闭的位置。

shared.en: Use a 6 foot (1.83m) stepladder to get access to the AIM.
shared.zh: 使用6英尺(1.83米)高的梯子来进入AIM。

shared.en: Remove the video monitor(s) if it is necessary to get access to the ceiling panels.
shared.zh: 如果有必要的话，拆除视频显示器来进入天花板面板。

shared.en: DO NOT GET THE PAINT MATERIALS IN YOUR MOUTH OR EYES, OR ON YOUR SKIN. DO NOT BREATHE PAINT FUMES. PUT ON PROTECTIVE SPLASH GOGGLES AND GLOVES WHEN YOU USE THESE MATERIALS.
shared.zh: 不要使油漆进入到你的嘴巴或眼睛，或碰到你皮肤。不要吸入油漆味道。当你使用这些材料时，戴上防溅的护目镜和手套。

shared.en: MAKE SURE THERE IS VENTILATION WHEN THE MERCURY AREA IS CLEANED. MERCURY VAPORS CAN BE TOXIC.
shared.zh: 在清洁有水银的区域时，确保通风良好。水银的气体是有毒的。

shared.en: MAKE SURE THAT PERSONS AND EQUIPMENT ARE CLEAR OF THE RUDDER, AILERONS AND THE TRAILING EDGE FLAPS.
shared.zh: 确保所有的人员和设备都远离方向舵、副翼和后缘襟翼。

shared.en: DO NOT LUBRICATE THE FITTING WITH TOO MUCH GREASE. TOO MUCH GREASE CAN CAUSE A FIRE.
shared.zh: 不要用太多的牛油来润滑装置。太多的牛油会导致火灾。

shared.en: ONLY USE THE SOLVENT IN AN AREA WITH GOOD AIR FLOW. THE SOLVENT YOU USE IS FLAMMABLE.
shared.zh: 只在空气流通良好的区域使用密封胶。你使用的密封胶是易燃物。

shared.en: DO NOT TOUCH OR BREATHE THE FUMES OF THE SEALANT. SEALANTS CONTAIN EPOXY RESIN. CLEAN YOUR HANDS FREQUENTLY.
shared.zh: 不要直接接触密封胶或吸入密封胶的气体。密封胶含有环氧树脂。经常清洗你的双手。

shared.en: BE CAREFUL WITH THE PANELS. THE SURFACES OF THE PANEL CAN BE DAMAGED WHEN YOU HIT THEM OR GET THEM DIRTY. IF YOU USE A LADDER OR SUPPORT EQUIPMENT, REFER TO PAGEBLOCK 20-09-01/201, FLOOR PANEL PROTECTION, FOR INSTRUCTIONS.
shared.zh: 小心处理面板。当你撞到它们或把它们弄脏时，它们就被损坏了。如果你使用梯子或支撑设备时，参考20-09-01/201页面-地板面板保护来获得指令。

shared.en: DO NOT PUT HEAVY WEIGHTS OVER THE CEILING PANELS. THE STRENGTH OF THE CEILING SUPPORT STRUCTURE IS NOT SUFFICIENT.
shared.zh: 不要把重物放在天花板面板之上。天花板支撑结构的力量不够。

shared.en: The primary purpose of the application of grease on the cable is for corrosion protection.
shared.zh: 在钢索上施加牛油的主要目的就是防腐蚀。

shared.en: THE CONTROL CABLES IN THE WING AND NACELLE AREA ARE NEAR HIGH TEMPERATURE SOURCES. DETERIORATION OF LUBRICANTS WILL OCCUR AT A FASTER RATE THAN ON OTHER CONTROL CABLES.
shared.zh: 在机翼和吊架区域的控制钢索是在高温源附近。会导致控制钢索润滑以更快的速度变质。

shared.en: OBEY THE MANUFACTURER'S PROCEDURES WHEN YOU DO MAINTENANCE THAT HAS AN EFFECT ON A CDCCL. IF YOU DO NOT OBEY THE PROCEDURES, IT CAN INCREASE THE RISK OF A SOURCE OF FUEL TANK IGNITION. INJURIES TO PERSONNEL, AND DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT CAN OCCUR IF THERE IS A FIRE OR EXPLOSION.
shared.zh: 当你在做会对CDCCL有影响的维修时，遵守生产商的程序。如果你不遵守程序，将会增加使油箱成为着火源的风险。如果发生火灾或爆炸，将会造成对人员伤亡和设备损坏。

shared.en: DO NOT CUT, CAUSE NICKS, OR CAUSE OTHER DAMAGE TO THE CABLES, WIRES, METAL-BRAIDED SHIELD, OR OVERBRAID. DAMAGE TO THESE COMPONENTS CAN CAUSE MALFUNCTIONS, OR DAMAGE TO OTHER EQUIPMENT.
shared.zh: 不要对钢索、电线、金属编织护罩或外罩进行切割、造成缺口或造成其它损坏。对这些部件造成的损坏可能导致故障或其它设备的损坏。

shared.en: DO NOT USE WIRE BUNDLES, TUBING, DUCTS, OR OTHER ENGINE COMPONENTS AS A STEP OR HAND-HOLD. DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT CAN OCCUR.
shared.zh: 不要把电线束、油管、管道或其它发动机部件当作梯子或扶手。这样会造成设备损坏。

shared.en: MAKE SURE THAT YOU REMOVE ALL TOOLS, LOOSE PARTS AND UNWANTED MATERIAL FROM THE AREA WHEN YOU COMPLETE MAINTENANCE. DAMAGE TO EQUIPMENT COULD OCCUR.
shared.zh: 当你完成维修时，确保你已从你的维修区域去除所有的工具、松动部件或不想要的材料。否则可能会导致设备的损坏。

shared.en: Use of methyl ethyl ketone (MEK) or acetone is not recommended.
shared.zh: 不建议使用MEK或丙酮。

AE.en: AILERON SYSTEM DE-ACTIVATED FOR MAINTENANCE REF TO AMM xx-xx-xx
AE.zh: 为了维修工作，根据AMM xx-xx-xx使副翼系统不工作

AE.en: BODY FAIRING CLOSE UP / OPEN UP AS PER AMM xx-xx-xx
AE.zh: 根据AMMxx-xx-xx装上/拆开机身整流罩

AE.en: BOOST PUMP REMOVED AS PER AMM xx-xx-xx
AE.zh: 根据AMMxx-xx-xx拆除燃油增加泵

AE.en: CHECK THE FUEL QUANTITY BY THE MEASURE STICK
AE.zh: 用油尺检查油量

AE.en: CLEAR FOR FLIGHT CONTROL OPERATION
AE.zh: 清场完毕，可进行飞行控制运行测试

AE.en: COCKPIT TO GND
AE.zh: 驾驶舱呼叫地面

AE.en: CUT HYDRAULIC / PNEUMATIC PWR
AE.zh: 关闭液压/气压动力

AE.en: FUEL SEEPED AROUND F/T ACCESS PANEL
AE.zh: 油箱盖周围渗油

AE.en: HYDRAULIC TUBE “B” NUT RETIGHTED AND LEAK CHKED RESULT “SATIS” AS PER AMM xx-xx-xx
AE.zh: 根据AMMxx-xx-xx重新锁紧液压油管“B” NUT，并进行试漏，结果没漏

AE.en: JETTISION PUMP REINSTALLED AS PER AMM xx-xx-xx. AND OPERATION CHKED RESULT “PASS”
AE.zh: 根据AMMxx-xx-xx装回应急抛油燃油泵，并进行运行测试，结果通过

AE.en: LIGHT CHANGE BLUE
AE.zh: 灯变成蓝色。

AE.en: PUSH BACK NOW / COMPLETE
AE.zh: 现在推后飞机/飞机推后完毕

AE.en: QAD RING TORQUE CHK CARRIED OUT AS PER AMM xx-xx-xx, RESULT WITHIN LIMIT
AE.zh: 根据AMMxx-xx-xx对快速装卸圈进行扭力测试，结果没超标

AE.en: SEALANT REMOVED AND NEW SEALANT REAPPLIED REF TO AMM xx-xx-xx
AE.zh: 根据AMMxx-xx-xx去除密封胶，并重新涂上新的密封胶

AE.en: SPOILER / AILERON MOVE TO UP/DOWN
AE.zh: 扰流板/副翼向上/向下运动

AE.en: SUPPORT THE TAIL JACK BEFORE FUEL TRANSFERRED TO H.STAB F/T
AE.zh: 在转移燃油去尾部油箱前，支撑位尾部开千斤顶

AE.en: T/R SYSTEM DE-ACTIVATED / RE-ACTIVATED FOR MAINTENANCE REF TO AMM xx-xx-xx
AE.zh: 为了维修需要，根据AMMxx-xx-xx使反推力系统不工作/恢复反推力系统功能

AE.en: TURN ON THE REFULING VALVE/ FUEL PUMP, VALVE OPEN /PUMP OPERATE
AE.zh: 打开加油阀门/燃油泵，阀门打开/燃油泵运行

AE.en: VIGV ACTUATOR / FUEL NOZZLE REPLACED AS PER AMM xx-xx-xx
AE.zh: 根据AMMxx-xx-xx更换可变位置进口导向叶片作动筒/燃油喷嘴

AE.en: Install caps on all the lines and ports to prevent contamination.
AE.zh: 在所有管的末端装上盖子以防止污染。

AE.en: Close the access panels opened earlier.
AE.zh: 早点关闭被打开的检修面板。

AE.en: Drain the reservoir fluid into the 15 gallon (57 liters) hydraulic fluid resistant container to a level below the hydraulic sample valve.
AE.zh: 将液压缸里的液压油排到15加仑(57升)的抗液压油容器，直到低于液压油样品阀门处。

AE.en: Operate the bleed valve on the reservoir pressurization module to release the pressure in the reservoir.
AE.zh: 操作液压缸加压模块上的排油阀，来释放液压缸里的压力。

AE.en: Release the pressure in the pneumatic system.
AE.zh: 释放气动系统的压力。

AE.en: Corrosion can cause failure of the aileron rod end attach bolt and the aileron reaction link pin assembly on the aileron power control unit.
AE.zh: 腐蚀会导致副翼末端连接螺栓和副翼动力控制组件上的副翼连杆插销的失效。

AE.en: When the outboard ailerons are unlocked, full outboard aileron travel of 25 degrees up through 15 degrees down is available.
AE.zh: 当外侧副翼没被锁上时，外侧副翼的向上25度和向下15度的全程活动都是可以实现的。

AE.en: Extend group A LE flaps to 5-unit position.
AE.zh: 将A组前缘襟翼展开至5个单位的位置。

AE.en: Rotate either aileron control wheel in CW or CCW direction to move ailerons.
AE.zh: 顺时针或逆时针旋转副翼控制轮盘来移动副翼。

AE.en: Move the captain's and first officer's control wheels to the neutral position.
AE.zh: 将机长和副机长的控制轮盘转到中心位置。

AE.en: The airplane must be correctly grounded to an approved ground before you defuel the airplane or open any fuel tanks.
AE.zh: 在你放燃油或打开任何一个油箱之前，飞机必须被接地到许可的地方。

AE.en: Only use approved explosion-proof flashlight that operate correctly in the fuel tanks.
AE.zh: 只有使用许可的可以在油箱里正确操作的防爆手电筒。

AE.en: Take a fuel sample from the tank sumps.
AE.zh: 从油箱排油口取样。

AE.en: After you clean the areas, inspect to make sure that protective finishes stay serviceable.
AE.zh: 在你清洁完这些区域之后，检查它们，来确保防护涂层仍然有用。

AE.en: If you find corrosion, repair or replace defective parts or structure.
AE.zh: 如果你发现腐蚀，修理或更换有缺陷的部件或结构。

AE.en: Remove dirt and collected debris from the doors and linkage, when you clean the landing gear or the wheel well.
AE.zh: 当你清洁起落架或轮舱时，去除门和连杆处的灰尘或堆积的毛刺。

AE.en: Make sure you install the ground locks in all landing gears.
AE.zh: 确保你在所有起落架上都安装了地面插销。

AE.en: Check that landing gear indicating and warning system is operating.
AE.zh: 检查起落架的显示和警告系统都在工作。

AE.en: Jack airplane for gear retraction.
AE.zh: 顶升飞机来收起轮子。

AE.en: Replace the components if they have too much contamination.
AE.zh: 如果零部件太脏了，更换它们。

AE.en: Start the APU and let the operation of the APU become stable
AE.zh: 启动APU，让它操作直到APU稳定下来。

AE.en: Let the APU operate until the APU bleed air has no smell of the oil contamination.
AE.zh: 转动APU，直到APU排出的空气没有任何滑油污染的味道。

AE.en: Apply the A00028 adhesive to the mating surfaces of the duct and the orifice.
AE.zh: 把A00028黏合剂涂到管道和孔的接合面。

AE.en: Remove the unwanted adhesive from the outer side of the duct and the orifice.
AE.zh: 从管道和孔的外面去除不想要的黏合剂。

AE.en: Align the straps or the clamps with the duct wall.
AE.zh: 将皮带或夹子和管道壁对齐。

AE.en: Immediately decrease the engine power until the engine surge stops.
AE.zh: 立刻降低发动机动力直到发动机喘震停止。

AE.en: Move the forward thrust lever to the IDLE position.
AE.zh: 将前推力杆推到慢车的位置。

AE.en: Safety the connectors with lockwire.
AE.zh: 为连接件打保险。

AE.en: Make sure that the red warning flags are clearly seen.
AE.zh: 确保红色的警告牌清晰可见。

AE.en: BE CAREFUL WHEN YOU MOVE THE COMPONENT. THE COMPONENT IS HEAVY. INJURIES TO PERSONS CAN OCCUR.
AE.zh: 当你移动这个部件时要小心。这个部件很重。可能会导致人员受伤。

AE.en: Loosely attach the connector [3] to the P5.0 manifold.
AE.zh: 松松地把接头(3)连接到P5.0总管上。

AV.en: Position transmitter adjusted and condition check found ‘satis’ as per MM xx-xx-xx
AV.zh: 位置传感器已调校完成，检查发现状况良好，参照MM

AV.en: Wire repaired/replaced and condition check c/out found ‘satis’ as per SWPM xx-xx-xx
AV.zh: 导线已修复/更换，状况检查良好，参照SWPM

AV.en: Oxygen/pitot-static system leak check performed found ‘satis’/within limit IAW MM xx-xx-xx.
AV.zh: 氧气/动静压系统漏气检查完成，结果良好，符合要求，参照MM

AV.en: Install the protective plug to all open ports on the removed oxygen cylinder.
AV.zh: 安装保护盖在所有拆下来的氧气瓶的开口上

AV.en: Make sure there is a minimum clearance of 0.1 inch between the tank unit and all tank structure.
AV.zh: 确保油量测量器和油箱结构之间有至少0.1英寸的距离

AV.en: Make sure that persons and equipment are clear of the L/E and T/E flaps
AV.zh: 确保人和设备都远离前缘和后缘襟翼

AV.en: Re-install the pitot-static probe
AV.zh: 再安装动静压管

AV.en: Measure the resistance between the strut of the pitot-static probe and the airplane skin with a bridge ohmmeter
AV.zh: 用桥式欧姆表测量动静压管直身和飞机蒙皮的电阻

AV.en: Use only oxygen-clean components in the oxygen system
AV.zh: 氧气系统只能用不会和氧气发生反应的部件

AV.en: Close the shutoff valve on the portable test cylinder
AV.zh: 关掉手提测试瓶上的关闭阀门

AV.en: Make sure the pressure does not decrease at a rate more than 15 psig per hour on the pressure gauge
AV.zh: 确保气压表上的气压下降不会超过15磅/平方英寸

AV.en: Verifying air flow through each mask
AV.zh: 确保氧气流进每个面罩

AV.en: PASS OXYGEN ON advisory message displays on EICAS
AV.zh: “乘客氧气系统开”的咨询性消息显示在EICAS上

AV.en: Momentarily move the PASS OXYGEN switch on the P5 pilot overhead panel to reset
AV.zh: 短暂的把驾驶员头上面板P5的乘客氧气控制开关打到RESET的位置

AV.en: Stop for 5 to 6 minutes to permit the systems to become stable
AV.zh: 停下来5到6分钟让系统变得稳定

AV.en: Push the functional test switch on the front panel of the left ADC
AV.zh: 压下左边大气数据机的功能测试按钮

AV.en: Examine the indicator lights on the fuel quantity processor unit
AV.zh: 检查油量处理机上的显示灯

AV.en: Make sure you hear a tone and the LED light flashs
AV.zh: 确保你听到一声和看到LED灯闪

AV.en: Make sure the pressure relief valve open
AV.zh: 确保气压释压阀门开

AV.en: CW OR CCW 1/4 turn
AV.zh: 顺时针或逆时针旋转1/4圈。

AV.en: Make sure the quality of the transmitted and received voice is good.
AV.zh: 确保被转换和收到的声音质量好。

AV.en: Push and release the VHF-R switch on the right RCP.
AV.zh: 推并释放右RCP上的VHF-R开关。

AV.en: Adjust the VHF-R volume control knob to approximately half of full volume.
AV.zh: 调整VHF-R声音控制旋钮，大概转到半圈。

AV.en: Make sure all three LEDs on the VHF transceiver front panel turn red for about two seconds.
AV.zh: 确保VHF接收器前面板上的3个LED灯变红，大概持续两秒。

AV.en: Any of the three LEDs that come on red after the self-test is completed indicates a defective condition.
AV.zh: 在测试完成后变为红色的3个LED灯中的任何一个显示有缺陷的状况。

AV.en: Make sure the display shows a value that is less than 25 percent of the FWD value.
AV.zh: 确保显示器显示的数值少于FWD数值的25%。

AV.en: Remove the electrical power if it is not necessary.
AV.zh: 如果不必要的话，断开电源。

AV.en: Remove the 10 bolts that attach the VHF antenna to the airplane.
AV.zh: 拆掉把VHF天线连接到飞机上的10个螺栓。

AV.en: While you hold the VHF antenna, disconnect the coaxial cable.
AV.zh: 在你固定VHF天线时，断开同轴电缆。

AV.en: Remove and keep the rubber O-ring from the VHF antenna.
AV.zh: 从VHF天线处拆除并保存橡皮O形环。

AV.en: BE VERY CAREFUL WHEN YOU DRAIN THE IDG OIL. USE GOGGLES, INSULATED GLOVES, AND PROTECTION GEAR. HOT OIL CAN CAUSE INJURIES.
AV.zh: 当你在排IDG滑油时要非常小心。戴上护目镜、隔热手套和防护服。热油可能会伤害人。

AV.en: Permit the oil that drains from the hose, to flow into the 2 U.S.-gallon container.
AV.zh: 允许从软管排出的滑油流进2加仑的容器中。

AV.en: Set the shutoff valve, on the leak test equipment, to OFF.
AV.zh: 把测漏设备上的关闭阀门设置到OFF。

AV.en: MAKE SURE THAT YOU DO NOT APPLY MORE THAN 50 PSI. TOO MUCH PRESSURE CAN CAUSE DAMAGE TO THE IDG.
AV.zh: 确保你不会施加多于50PSI的压力。太大的压力可能会对IDG造成损坏。

AV.en: Visually examine the system for a leak.
AV.zh: 目测检查系统，看看是否有裂缝。

AV.en: Repair the leaks you find and do the leak check again.
AV.zh: 修补你发现的裂缝，再次对裂缝处进行检查。

AV.en: Release the pressure from the IDG oil system
AV.zh: 释放IDG滑油系统的压力。

AV.en: Discard the filter element and the O-ring.
AV.zh: 丢弃过滤器的滤芯和O形圈。

AV.en: During the ground test, make sure that the red and yellow LEDs on the DFDAC come on.
AV.zh: 在地面测试时，确保DFDAC上的红色和黄色LED灯亮起。

AV.en: Do a test of the longitudinal acceleration signal.
AV.zh: 为纵向的加速信号做个测试。

AV.en: Remove the safety tag and close this circuit breaker
AV.zh: 拆除安全标签，关闭这个电路断流器。

AV.en: When the software installation is completed, make sure the COMP indication shows on the data loader.
AV.zh: 软件安装完毕时，确保COMP显示在数据加载器上。

AV.en: Wait approximately 30-seconds before proceeding to the next step.
AV.zh: 在你进行下一步之前，等待大概30秒。

AV.en: The master warning lights and the siren can be reset.
AV.zh: 主警告灯和警报器可以被重新设置。

AV.en: The firebell warning sounds for one second on and nine seconds off.
AV.zh: 防火警铃一秒钟后响起，九秒钟后停。

AV.en: The two frequency values used are 1 KHz ±0.1 KHz and 2 KHz ±0.1 KHz. The time constant is 33 ±2 seconds.
AV.zh: 被使用的2个频率值是1±0.1 赫兹和2±0.1 赫兹。持续时间是33±2 秒。

AV.en: Set a switch for the access lights to the on position.
AV.zh: 把进入灯的开关设置到ON的位置。

AV.en: Turn the dimmer control counterclockwise to a position where the dome lights change to a dim intensity.
AV.zh: 逆时针旋转调光器控制旋钮到使驾驶舱灯变为灰暗模式。

AV.en: Make sure the captain and first officer's dome lights changed from dim to bright intensity.
AV.zh: 确保机长和副机长灯由灰暗模式变为明亮模式。

AV.en: Make sure the ceiling lights and the sidewall washlights come on.
AV.zh: 确保天花板灯和侧壁灯亮起。

AI.en: Cabin pressurization test performed as per AMM ***, and result satisfactory.
AI.zh: 根据AMM***完成对客舱的增压测试，结果满意。

AI.en: The placard found detached /illegible /torn.
AI.zh: 这张标牌发现脱落/字迹模糊/损坏。

AI.en: Clean /lubricate the control cable as per AMM***.
AI.zh: 根据AMM***清洁/润滑控制系统钢索。

AI.en: The overhead bin doors found misalign /hard to operated /snubber function failure.
AI.zh: 吊挂行李舱舱门发现不对齐/难以操作/缓冲器功能损坏。

AI.en: The lavatory toilet shroud found paint stripped/aging.
AI.zh: 厕所马桶罩发现油漆脱落/老化。

AI.en: The portable fire bottle weight check due date found time expired.
AI.zh: 便携式灭火器重量检查超出期限。

AI.en: Toilet flush functional check performed, result satisfied as per AMM***.
AI.zh: 根据AMM***完成盥洗室冲水系统的功能测试，结果满意。

AI.en: FWD cargo door FWD rotary actuator found abnormal noise during operational check, please troubleshooting.
AI.zh: 前货舱门前转动装置发现不正常的噪音，请排除故障。

AI.en: CIC (corrosion inhibition compound) applied/spray as per AMM***.
AI.zh: 根据AMM***喷涂防腐剂。

AI.en: Note: certain filters are now cleanable. If a cleanable filter is installed, cleaning is acceptable over discard.
AI.zh: 注释：某些气滤目前是可清洗的。如果安装的是可清洗的气滤，以清洗代替报废是可以接受的。

AI.en: Remove the preformed packing that keeps the air filter on the vacuum blower.
AI.zh: 将气滤固定到真空鼓风机上的预制型密封圈拆除。

AI.en: Verify the operation of the vacuum blower of the toilet waste system.
AI.zh: 检查厕所污水系统真空鼓风机的操作。

AI.en: Warning: drain, or use the potable water system a minimum of one time each three days. If you do not drain, or use the water system frequently, bacteria can grow in the water. If you drink water with bacteria in it, illness can occur.
AI.zh: 警告：饮用水系统最少每三天排干或者使用一次。如果不经常排干或者使用饮用水系统，水里面将会有细菌滋生。饮用这种水将会引起疾病。

AI.en: Remove the water filter cartridge from the water filters in the lavatories, galleys, and wet bar if it is applicable.
AI.zh: 如果厕所、厨房和柜台有安装食水过滤器，把过滤筒拆除。

AI.en: In the upper deck lavatory that is the farthest forward, open the HOT and COLD water faucet for 6 minutes or until you smell chlorine in the water.
AI.zh: 打开上层客舱最前端厕所里的热水和冷水水龙头6分钟，或者直到你闻到水中有氯的味道。

AI.en: Make sure the instruction decal and the nameplate are in good condition.
AI.zh: 确保指示标牌和铭牌状态良好。

AI.en: Examine the pressure gage and make sure the extinguisher has the correct pressure.
AI.zh: 检查压力表并确保灭火瓶的压力正确。

AI.en: Replace the bottle if it weighs less than the weight marked on the bottle by 10 grams or more.
AI.zh: 如果灭火瓶重量少于标签上所标重量10克或者更多，更换灭火瓶。

AI.en: Check the lavatory fire extinguishers temperature indicator for change of color from gray to black to determine if bottle has discharged.
AI.zh: 检查厕所灭火瓶温度指标牌颜色是否由灰变黑，以判定灭火瓶是否已释放。

AI.en: Electrically open the door until it is one foot from the door closed position
AI.zh: 使用电动装置打开门直到其距离关闭的位置有一英尺。

AI.en: Turn the internal manual drive 50 turns counterclockwise.
AI.zh: 把手动驱动器朝逆时针转动50转。

AI.en: Install the screws and washers to hold the inlet screen to the duct.
AI.zh: 安装螺丝和垫圈在固定进口滤网到管道上。

AI.en: Make sure the orifice at the bottom of the filter recess (housing) in the valve is not blocked.
AI.zh: 确保活门里面的过滤器槽的底部下的量孔没有堵住。

AI.en: Use the torque wrench to move the brake housing in the direction that will cause it to engage the pawls.
AI.zh: 使用转矩扳手转动制动器箱，可接上啮合棘爪。

AI.en: Remove the lock bolt from the adjusting ring.
AI.zh: 从调整环上移除锁紧螺栓。

AI.en: Install the fasteners loosely on the clevis (U形夹).
AI.zh: 将螺母装在U形夹上，不要紧固。

AI.en: On the outboard side of the valve, remove the clamshell coupling and move the sleeve outboard.
AI.zh: 在活门的外侧，拆除蛤壳型接合器和外部衬套移開。

AI.en: Gain access to window shade housing STA210 LHS by removing side wall per MM25-21.
AI.zh: 把左站位210侧壁盖板除下，以便接近靠近窗口遮阳板的框架。

AI.en: Perform a function check of the L/H NO.5 main entry door emergency escape linkage. Ref. AMM 52-11-07-206-011.
AI.zh: 按照AMM工序52-11-07-206-011进行左5门逃生系统连杆的功能测试。

AI.en: If S/N does not match with header and remaining life is more than 3 months. Do not change the bottle.
AI.zh: 如序列号是和标题不是相同但使用期超出3个月。不要更换气瓶。

AI.en: Caution: When performing following, it is necessary to access overhead or floor level reservoir. Therefore, be careful not to move toggle lever, if toggle lever moves, door may open suddenly and it cause damage or injuries.
AI.zh: 警告：当进行以下工序时，是会靠近到门顶或地板上的气瓶，要小心不要碰到气瓶上的(TOGGLE LEVER)起动杆，如不小心碰到，门会即刻打开，会造成损坏或把人弄伤。

AI.en: Remove following galley and lavatory if necessary
AI.zh: 如有需要，拆除以下厨房或厕所。

AI.en: Install painted actuator ASSY per AMM52-xx-xx.
AI.zh: 按照AMM52-xx-xx把喷漆的作动筒组件安装。

AI.en: Install disconnected pressure line tube assembly (组合) with thread compound.
AI.zh: 把拆下来的气管喉螺纹涂上螺纹用的混合物來组合接口。

AI.en: Spray AV-8 to the painted area of actuator external surface and connection area of pressure line.
AI.zh: 在作动筒外部有上漆和气管接口位喷上AV-8。

AI.en: Install the doorway sidewall lining located at med FWD area.
AI.zh: 把客舱门前门口位前的侧壁板安装上。

AI.en: Perform a functional check of the upper deck floor mounted escape system.
AI.zh: 进行上层客舱安装在地板上的逃生系统的功能检查。

AI.en: Perform a functional check of the upper deck door ratchet (拉拉) disc brake.
AI.zh: 对上舱门棘齿（拉拉）制动盘制动进行功能检查。

AI.en: Discard the over head recirculation fan PREFILTERS (optional combination PREFILTERS and particulate filter configuration) and replace with new fan PREFILTERS.
AI.zh: 丢弃并更换顶部再循环风扇气滤。

AI.en: Inspect the portable (HALON) fire extinguishers for proper pressure, weight and condition.
AI.zh: 检查便携卤素(HALON)灭火瓶合适的压力，重量和状况。

AI.en: Check the pressure of the PDU tire in main deck and lower lobe cargo compartment loading systems.
AI.zh: 检查主货舱和下货舱装载系统的PDU轮胎压力。

AI.en: Clean E/E equipment cooling system blower inlet screen.
AI.zh: 清洁E/E设备冷却系统吹风机进口滤网。

AI.en: Perform a detailed internal inspection of the crew compartment overhead hatch operating mechanism.
AI.zh: 执行驾驶舱顶部(逃生)舱门操纵机构的详细内部检查。

AI.en: Perform an operational check to verify manual drive of main deck side cargo door lift mechanism.
AI.zh: 执行操作检查主舱侧货舱门提升机械装置是否可用手驱动。

AI.en: Check the lavatory fire extinguishers temperature indicator for change of color from gray to black to determine if bottle has discharged.
AI.zh: 检查厕所灭火瓶温度指示器颜色有否由灰变黑，以判定灭火瓶是否释放。

AI.en: Check the lavatory fire extinguishers for weight and condition.
AI.zh: 检查厕所灭火瓶重量和状况。

AI.en: Disinfect the potable water supply system.
AI.zh: 消毒饮用水供应系统。

AI.en: Restore the toilet waste vacuum blower cooling air inlet filter. (If installed)
AI.zh: 更换污水箱真空鼓风机冷却空气进口气滤。(如有安装)

AI.en: Discard the cabin pressure positive pressure relief valve filters.
AI.zh: 拆下并更换客舱压力正释压活门气滤。
